title: Keep positions fixed while possibilities disappear
communicates: Which possibilities remain after a decision.

source.title: Up and Down the Ladder of Abstraction
source.locator: Concrete examples, changing parameters, comparing outcomes

observation: The essay connects concrete instances and broader parameter-space views.
interpretation: Keeping each candidate in its original position lets elimination be read without mentally tracking a rearrangement. This is an authored design pattern.
avoid: Moving surviving values into a new order.
Fading a value without explaining why it was excluded.
Changing an established symbol’s meaning to fit this pattern.
Choosing this pattern merely because a source paragraph can be animated.
